story.title: Our Story
story.p1: Nass Split was born from the common frustration of splitting bills with roommates. It started with a coffee-stained spreadsheet and an awkward conversation about who owed what for the utility bill.
story.p2: We realized that the problem wasn't just about the money—it was about the friction it created in friendships. We built Nass Split to replace complex math with simple clicks, and tension with clarity.

items.question: Is Nass Split free?
items.answer: Yes, Nass Split is free to use for core splitting and group management. We offer a premium tier for automated bank syncing and detailed financial reporting, but the essential features will always remain free for everyone.

items.question: How do I invite roommates?
items.answer: Tap the 'Groups' tab, select your household, and hit 'Invite Members'. You can share a unique invite link or scan a QR code to get everyone on board instantly.

items.question: Is my data secure?
items.answer: Absolutely. We use 256-bit AES encryption and never store your sensitive bank credentials. Your financial privacy is our top priority.

items.question: How do I settle up?
items.answer: When you're ready to clear balances, Nass Split calculates the 'Optimal Path'—minimizing the total number of transfers. You can record a payment as cash or link your preferred payment app to settle instantly.
